evidence.decision: Chooses actual persistent contextual tools, favors standard toolbar/tab components and specifies bounded attached placement with deliberate hide/restore.
evidence.artifact: Delivers window/ornament layout, width, attachment and visibility/restore specification or scoped implementation.
evidence.transformation: Spatial score editor replaces oversized duplicate-toolbar and rare-tool panels with standard toolbar, inline rare commands and only justified frequent information.
evidence.verification: Checks narrow/moved/scrolled/hidden states; fails blocked window controls, content occlusion or tools drifting away from their window.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly visionOS-only; preserves standard borderless feedback and separates spatial attachment/comfort/gaze execution from static layout.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Toolbars for system presentation and Designing for visionOS only for relevant spatial context.
evidence.distinctiveness: Window-relative persistence, forward parallel plane and ornament width/weight determine concrete spatial tool placement.
